items.title: Every drone that flies over a city is one motor failure from being a falling object. This startup is building a safety kit to combat such failures.
items.summary: The Bengaluru-based Saubha Aerial Systems has developed an autonomous parachute trigger for drones, and has since tested a netgun for catching hostile ones.
